audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phase reasons are shared template text, and three of them call Illaoi 'he'.
audit.why: Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 and Harsh Lesson only 4s — the short leap is what lands on you between her E casts, and the template named neither number.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten around Test of Spirit's 16s, Harsh Lesson's leap and the tentacle field, in second person.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 said only 'her ultimate changes the math too' and the item stages gave no reason.
audit.why: Leap of Faith is 120s at rank 1 and spawns a tentacle per champion hit, so at 6 the field she fights in doubles. Your spike is Lich Bane used away from her tentacles.
audit.corrected: phases[4] names Leap of Faith and the tentacle spawn; phases[5] and phases[6] tie your all-ins to fighting outside the field.

audit.whatIsWrong: The trap that decides this lane was never stated: running away from your ripped spirit is what turns you into a Vessel, so dashing out with E or R is exactly wrong.
audit.why: Riot's description of Test of Spirit: 'If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel and begin spawning Tentacles.' Also missing: Harsh Lesson is a targeted leap, so Twilight Shroud denies it a target, while ground-placed Tentacle Smash still lands. Prophet of an Elder God heals her whenever a tentacle hits a champion.
audit.corrected: The Vessel rule is in phases[3].why, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t; the targeted-leap split in phases[1].why and dosFull[2].d; the healing and its anti-heal answer in phases[2].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Test of Spirit 16/15/14/13/12, Harsh Lesson a flat 4s, Tentacle Smash 10s and Leap of Faith 120s at rank 1; your W is 20s and E 16s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[1], phases[3], phases[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Burn shroud early' was described as diving with no shroud and no energy.
audit.why: Shared template copy, with the wrong pronoun for Illaoi.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title, in the right pronoun.

edits.before: Shroud her E — Q-poke away from tentacles. Akali wins the Test of Spirit cooldown windows.
edits.after: Shroud her E — never run from your own spirit. Akali wins the Test of Spirit cooldown windows.

edits.before: Shroud her E and poke her down. Track Test of Spirit before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud her E and poke her down. Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1 — that gap is your kill window.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Illaoi contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Tentacle Smash outranges your kunai 850 to 550 and her tentacles heal her. Farm at Q tip and take nothing.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Illaoi's Test of Spirit is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites her trade: Harsh Lesson is targeted, so from smoke her leap finds nothing.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Illaoi must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but every tentacle that lands on you heals her — bring Grievous Wounds before you commit anything.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Test of Spirit's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: after Test of Spirit (16s), running from your spirit is what makes you a Vessel — kill it or stay near.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Illaoi's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, but Leap of Faith (120s) spawns a tentacle per champion hit — never fight her inside her own field.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Test of Spirit's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight away from her tentacles, on her E cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Illaoi carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and one rotation kills her, but her field scales with bodies — take the 1v1, never the teamfight.

edits.before: - Illaoi Test of Spirit: matchup-defining — Her vessel pull. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Test of Spirit (16s at rank 1): do not dash away from your spirit or you become a Vessel. - Harsh Lesson (4s): targeted, so smoke denies it. - Leap of Faith (120s): one tentacle per champion hit, so fight her alone.

edits.before: Q Illaoi at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q her at 550 away from terrain, E-mark and dash once Test of Spirit is spent, then Shroud her leap.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Dashing away from your own ripped spirit — the distance is what turns you into a Vessel.

edits.before: Q Illaoi at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Her leap is targeted, so vanishing as she casts leaves Harsh Lesson with nothing to jump to.

edits.before: Illaoi wastes Test of Spirit — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Tentacles spawn on impassable terrain — fight her in the open lane.

edits.before: That is Illaoi's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Each tentacle that connects heals her, and there is no cap on how many swing.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Distance from the spirit is what makes you a Vessel — stay close.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Shroud is your answer to the targeted leap, so never spend it on her ground-cast poke.

edits.before: Track Illaoi's Test of Spirit: Her vessel pull. Shroud-dodge it. When it is down — E-Q + R her.
edits.after: Running from your ripped spirit makes you a Vessel. Harsh Lesson is targeted, so smoke denies it.

notes: The kit file flags Leap of Faith with 'grounding' and 'untargetable'. Riot's description says only that it smashes down, damages nearby enemies and spawns a tentacle per champion hit — nothing about grounding or untargetability — so per the description-beats-flag rule I wrote neither. If Leap of Faith really does ground, that would matter enormously to Akali's E and R and should be confirmed and added. Also, the full layer refers to Illaoi as 'he' in tradeGood and dontsFull[0].d; fixed here, but the same template text is spread across the champion file.
